plan.name: Apply captured test conventions to regression files
plan.summary: Complete issue #654 in one plumbing change: admit new regular regression files under captured repository test conventions, using the whole touched Python or TypeScript part as decided in F1 A, including separate test directories and sibling test areas, while preserving Go's exact package, new-package and nearest embedded-asset ownership. Use one policy for writable-file discovery, staging, the CLI test tool and registered checks, formatting and suite execution, final copying and CI scope; intersect framework-conventional filenames with captured suite targets and default or literal discovery settings, protect test configuration, and refuse implicit additions whose discovery membership cannot be established without executing repository policy. Keep the original checkout fixed through repairs and use the diff's merge base in CI, allowing correction or removal of this build's additions while protecting existing unnamed tests, other production files, unrelated parts, links, acceptance sources and plan records, and retaining deleted-package handling and legacy Go hashes and locks. Add offline acceptance and regression coverage of these paths, including failing added tests and format checks, update the existing native fixtures that describe the former Go-only allowance, and keep candidate policy edits from granting permission or hiding admitted regressions from checks. Update planner, builder and reviewer instructions, SPEC.md with supporting decision citations, the README within 400 lines and docs/factory.md to describe the allowance and its supported discovery forms without enabling external intake; the merger records the decision for this step and F1 A before the next parent step, since this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestConfiguredRegressionBuild654
tests.says: Captured pytest, Vitest and Jest conventions admit separate and colocated regression files throughout a touched part; Go retains exact package ownership. Tool checks, fresh final checks, review, repair and copy-back see the same admitted files, preserve pinned and unnamed baseline files, and discard changes outside the plan.

tests.name: TestConfiguredRegressionFailures654
tests.says: Added regression files reach the captured formatting and test commands; a failure in either blocks review and readiness, including a regression changed after a passing tool run.

tests.name: TestConfiguredRegressionLinks654
tests.says: A conventional regular regression is copied, but a symbolic link, hard link or linked ancestor at the same allowed path never supplies test or copied bytes.

tests.name: TestConfiguredRegressionScope654
tests.says: CI admits the same conventional files and refuses unrelated parts, excluded paths, production and configuration lookalikes, existing unnamed tests and changed pinned sources or records; novelty and discovery policy come from the merge base even after the target branch deletes a test or changes policy.

tests.name: TestConfiguredRegressionTool654
tests.says: The real plumbing test tool retains a newly added conventional Python regression through its staging boundary and reports the captured suite's failure, without accepting a candidate repository policy or an unnamed production file.
